_price_source_options: universal_cmp (CMP column of the Universal Sheet) | broker_ltp (LTP column of the broker file)
_narrative_provider_options: auto (Gemini when .env has NARRATIVE_PROVIDER=gemini and a key, else manual) | manual (only read narrative.json you paste in; no network calls) | gemini. A saved narrative.json is always reused; delete it to have Gemini write a new one.
_rating_provider_options: auto (Gemini rates blank Rating/Sentiment when .env has a key, else the draft rules if approved) | gemini | rules. A value typed in the Universal Sheet always wins. Views always come from the Universal Sheet only.
